description: Cloudless validated versions. `apps` and `infra` pin Docker images (daemon pulls <image>@<digest>, overriding the catalog tag); `models` pins Hugging Face weights by revision. Anything not listed falls back to the catalog/default. OpenClaw is Cloudless-built; Hermes uses the official Nous Research image. Set `verified:true` only for things tested on Cloudless hardware; to ship a new validated version, move the current digest/revision to `rollback` and replace it.

vllm.notes: Inference engine. Validated on RTX 5090 / Blackwell (D12).

sglang.notes: Alternative inference engine. Validated on RTX 5090 / Blackwell (D13).

open-webui.notes: Chat UI. Verified working with the Cloudless engine.

comfyui.notes: Image generation. Pinned from upstream; NOT yet validated on Blackwell (sm_120).

ai-toolkit.notes: Ostris image-model trainer. Pinned from upstream; not yet validated on Cloudless hardware.

unsloth.notes: LLM fine-tuning (Jupyter). Pinned from upstream; not yet validated on Cloudless hardware.

openclaw.notes: Autonomous agent, built by Cloudless. Runs and reaches the engine (D16). Rebuild from internal/apps/openclaw and re-push to update.

hermes.notes: Official Hermes Agent v0.19.0 image. Registry digest pinned; dashboard, local Cloudless AI connection, persistence and messaging still require appliance validation.

cloudflared.notes: Cloudflare quick-tunnel client for the 'share online' feature. Verified live (HTTP 200 round-trip).

socat.notes: TCP forwarder for the 'local network' feature.

default.notes: Default Cloudless AI model served by the engine. Validated on Blackwell (D12).
